When the Angels of the Tenth Realm—Heven—waged war on Asgard, Odin's daughter and heir to Asgard's throne was kidnapped by the Queen of Angels. While sealed away, Aldrif was discovered to have survived and was then raised— hidden from her true heritage— as Angela, Huntress of Heven.

As all secrets eventually come to light, Angela uncovered the truth of her upbringing. Now, shunned from Heven and branded a traitor to Asgard, Angela roams across the realms to find her place within it—continuing her hunt wherever it takes her.

9498618413951091973.String:
#listheader#CREATE POWERFUL ITEMS FOR YOUR HEROES!#/listheader#
The crafting system of Marvel Heroes provides three ways to improve your hero: improving your existing gear; adding special game effects to your costume; and creating consumable items that provide short-term benefits.

#listheader#Visit a CRAFTER#/listheader#
Each base has a special vendor, called a #emphasis#crafter#/emphasis#, who can create or improve items for you. The first crafter you meet is Hank Pym, found in Avengers Tower. 

#listheader#Crafting uses RECIPES#/listheader#
Everything that you can build or improve requires its own #emphasis#recipe#/emphasis#: a list of ingredients required for that task. The recipes available to you appear in your crafter's vendor panel.  

#mission#Mouse over#/mission# a recipe to see more details about it, including its required ingredients.

As your crafter gains #emphasis#ranks#/emphasis# (see below), he or she will offer a wider range of recipes. You can also find new recipes by defeating enemies. When you have a new recipe in your inventory, just #mission#Use this item#/mission# on the recipe to add it to your crafter's list of recipes.

#red#Watch Out! All Recipes Require Credits#/red#
In addition to the ingredients listed, all recipes also require the expenditure of credits. 

#red#Tip! All Crafters Are The Same#/red#
Even though your crafters have different names, they all share the same rank and know the same recipes. 

#listheader#Recipes require ELEMENTS#/listheader#
The simplest ingredients used in recipes are called #emphasis#elements#/emphasis#. Almost any recipe you encounter will require at least one element. 

There are four kinds of elements:
-	#emphasis#Ionic Particle#/emphasis#
-	#emphasis#Nanotech Filament#/emphasis#
-	#emphasis#Astral Essence#/emphasis#
-	#emphasis#Enhanced Genome#/emphasis#

You can find elements by defeating enemies.

#listheader#Crafters have a RANK#/listheader#
Just like your hero starts at level 1, each crafter starts at #emphasis#rank#/emphasis# 1. A crafter's rank determines which recipes that crafter knows. As the crafter gains ranks, the list of recipes available to you from that crafter expands.

You can increase a crafter's rank by donating unwanted items to any crafter. This works a lot like selling items to a vendor. When the crafter panel is open, #mission#hold ALT and Use this item#/mission# on the item you want to donate. This destroys the item and gives the crafter some #emphasis#XP#/emphasis#. When the crafter's yellow XP bar fills up, the crafter advances to the next rank.

#red#Tip! Better Items Are Worth More XP#/red#
The more valuable the item you donate, the more XP the crafter earns. Hold down #mission#ALT#/mission# when the crafter panel is open to see how much XP your inventory items are worth.

#red#Tip! All Crafters Are The Same#/red#
We said it before, but it's worth stating again. All your crafters have the same rank and know the same recipes. Donating an item to any crafter gives XP to all of your crafters.

#listheader#It's time to CRAFT SOMETHING#/listheader#
When you want a crafter to create or improve an item, follow this procedure.

#mission#Left-click#/mission# on the crafter to bring up the crafter panel.
- 	#mission#Left-click#/mission# on the recipe you want to use.
- 	#mission#Use this item#/mission# on the ingredients in your inventory that the recipe requires.
- 	If needed, #mission#Use this item#/mission# on the item the recipe will modify.
- 	Once all ingredients the recipe needs have been added, the Create button will highlight.
- 	#mission#Left-click#/mission# the Create button to complete the recipe.
- 	Wait for the crafting process to finish.
- 	#mission#Left-click#/mission# the Take All Items button to put the crafted or modified item(s) into your inventory.

#red#Watch Out! Crafting Is Final#/red#
You can't undo crafting, so once you make or modify an item, you've permanently lost the materials and the credits that went into making it. Be sure you really want to craft that item before you click Create!

9499384528886236546.String:
Norman Osborn was never a very sane man. Growing up under an abusive father and the loss of his wife was enough to push any man over the edge, but Norman Osborn had much further to fall still. While reverse-engineering an experimental serum Norman created a volatile concoction that exploded in his face and finally drove him to become the violent madman, The Green Goblin!
Always thirsting for power, the Green Goblin has made a career out of being stopped by his least favorite super hero, the Amazing Spider-Man. Yet ever the sly one, Osborn has always eluded punishment for his crimes as the Green Goblin, even becoming leader of the Thunderbolts and eventually being promoted to Director of H.A.M.M.E.R., S.H.I.E.L.D.'s replacement. Norman Osborn has a long and cruel list of crimes to atone for, but maybe, just maybe, he can do some good while he's trying to fool everyone.

9693355095900161292.String:
The program we stuck into A.I.M.'s system wasn't just a virus. It also told us exactly how they got past Stark's firewalls.

Apparently, Madame HYDRA herself gave M.O.D.O.K. some kind of extremely advanced security bypass device. In exchange, A.I.M. agreed to build HYDRA an army of Hulkbuster-level battlesuits based on Stark's armor designs.

I'm sick and tired of just following their little schemes around the planet.  So this time, we're going directly to the source: #mission#HYDRA Island#/mission#.

This frozen little speck of rock in the North Pacific may not look like much, but our intel says that HYDRA's built themselves a cozy little base capable of withstanding anything short of a tactical nuke.

9795952703434196232.String:
The Skrull Invasion has been uncovered!

You acquired information as to the whereabouts of the real Nick Fury from the main console in the Helicarrier. This intel led you to Madripoor; specifically the Lowtown section, where the old S.H.I.E.L.D. Recon Post is located.

It wasn't smooth sailing all the way to the Recon Post, however, as a turf war had broken out between the Hand and the Serpent Warriors after HYDRA's forces had been routed from the area. Battling through the chaos, you eventually made your way to the barber shop which housed the secret entrance to the Recon Post.

Once inside, you found that the entire place had been demolished by some unknown and long-gone force. You were thorough in your search and found a conspicuous, holographic wall panel near the back that led you to your goal.

Behind the Recon Post, the real Nick Fury awaited you in his newest base of operations: Fury's Toolshed. He updated you on the situation and bid you to speak with Abigail Brand, the Director of S.W.O.R.D.

#emphasis#Real Name:#/emphasis# Angela
#emphasis#Identity:#/emphasis# Public Identity

When the Angels of the Tenth Realm, Heven, waged war on Asgard, Odin's daughter and heir to Asgard's throne was kidnapped by the Queen of Angels. But Odin would not be extorted by the Angels, and his daughter, Aldrif, was seemingly slain. Odin retaliated by severing Heven from Yggdrasil and closed it off from the other Nine Realms. While sealed away, Aldrif was discovered to have survived and was then raised—hidden from her true heritage—as Angela, Huntress of Heven.

As all secrets eventually come to light, Angela uncovered the truth of her upbringing. Now, shunned from Heven and branded a traitor to Asgard, Angela roams across the realms to find her place within it—continuing her hunt wherever it takes her.

#emphasis#Created By:#/emphasis# Neil Gaiman, Todd McFarlane

But enough about me. I'm not sure how much you've heard, but the synthetic Mutant Growth Hormone that A.I.M. has whipped up is making major problems in this area. Even though this isn't my normal territory, I figured I'd help out.

The good news is that I've tracked down the location of the #mission#MGH Factory#/mission# that's producing the stuff. 

Unfortunately, it's heavily guarded, both by armed A.I.M. goons and one of Kingpin's heavy hitters: a guy named #mission#Tombstone#/mission#.

Shannon Carter (cousin of Sharon Carter) idolized the legendary Avenger, Captain America, while growing up. Inspired by his actions, Shannon trained in the Captain's footsteps and excelled well into peak condition as a skilled combatant.

While working as a mercenary in Egypt, Marc Spector stumbled upon an archaeological dig where he had an altercation with his fellow mercenary, Raoul Bushman. This altercation resulted in him dying in front of a statue of the Egyptian God of Vengeance, Khonshu. Khonshu raised Spector from the dead as his Blade of Vengeance and gave him the power to defeat his former accomplice, Bushman. Upon his return to the United States, Marc created multiple identities in order to distance himself from his past while maintaining connections to multiple facets of society and became the masked vigilante known as Moon Knight.

#emphasis#Real Name:#/emphasis#  James Buchanan "Bucky" Barnes
#emphasis#Identity:#/emphasis# Secret

Originally the teenage sidekick of Captain America, Bucky Barnes was thrust into a life of torture and black ops work after being caught in an explosion caused by Baron Zemo. Post-explosion, Bucky was captured by a secret organization in Russia that used cryogenic freezing and advanced mind-wiping techniques to use him as an assassin whenever he was needed for decades. It was not until battling Captain America face to face (and with the assistance of the Cosmic Cube) that Bucky was able to fight his forced programming and reclaim his position as a hero. He now works with S.H.I.E.L.D. alongside Black Widow, and has even acted as Captain America for a time.

Following in his father's footsteps, Nicholas Joseph Fury enlisted in the armed services during World War II and would ultimately command one of the Allied forces' most elite squads—the Howling Commandos. But as the war took its toll, an explosive injury would cause him to become immunized with the Infinity Formula to save his life.

As the compound slowed his aging over time, Fury was recruited by the CIA as one of their toughest and elusive field agents. #emphasis#Real Name:#/emphasis# Kurt Wagner
#emphasis#Identity:#/emphasis# Secret

Estranged son of the evil mutant Mystique, Kurt Wagner was raised by a fortune teller and grew up as part of a travelling circus in Germany. Using his unique physique and agility, he performed as the star acrobat for years until finally attempting escape. During this escape, Nightcrawler teleported for the first time, an event that lead to him being rescued from an angry mob by Professor Charles Xavier, who came to recruit him into the X-Men.
 
From there, Nightcrawler became a mainstay of the X-Men's various incarnations, as well as other teams such as Excalibur. He uses his teleportation, expert swordsmanship and superhuman agility to defeat enemies quickly, but maintains a light-hearted and positive attitude and serves as a moral anchor for the team.

#emphasis#Created By:#/emphasis# Len Wein and Dave Cockrum
#emphasis#First Appearance:#/emphasis# Giant-Size X-Men #1 (May 1975)

Following in his father's footsteps, Nicholas Joseph Fury enlisted in the armed services during World War II and would ultimately command one of the Allied forces' most elite squads—the Howling Commandos. #listheader#KL'RT IS ONLY THE BEGINNING!#/listheader#
Defeating Kl'rt marks the end of the main story, but there's still much work for a hero to do!

Throughout your journey you've gained access to many game modes. In these modes you can battle dangerous Super Villains and find the best gear.

There are several different kinds of PvE content, each with a variety of maps and difficulties:

#listheader#Operations#/listheader#
In a #emphasis#Operation#/emphasis#, you must navigate an instance to defeat the Super Villain boss who lurks within. Operations can be completed solo or with a group. They scale in difficulty (and rewards) with the number of players in your group. Operations are unlocked at level 20.

Operations can be accessed from the Operations tab after interacting with a Waypoint.

#red#Cube Shards#/red#
Once a day when you complete a Operation, the boss will drop more valuable rewards, including a #emphasis#Cube Shard#/emphasis#. 

For example, when you defeat Shocker in the Abandoned Subway Operation he drops better rewards (including a Cube Shard). If you complete that same mission again in the same day, his rewards revert to normal. 

When you gather enough Cube Shards, you can turn them in for items such as a #emphasis#Fortune Card#/emphasis#! You can deliver your Cube Shards to any Cube Shard Collector in any Hub.

#listheader#One-Shot Stories#/listheader#
Similar to Operations, in a #emphasis#One-Shot Story#/emphasis#, you must navigate an instance and defeat the super villain boss within. The environments in One-Shot Stories are much larger and players face additional objectives. One-Shot Stories can be completed solo or with a group.

One-Shot Stories take more time to complete than Operations and the bosses may prove to be more difficult. One-Shot stories are unlocked after you reach level 20.

#red#Commendations#/red#
The first time you complete a One-Shot Story each day, the boss(es) within will drop Commendations if you have not yet reached the weekly cap.  Players can earn Commendations from each One-Shot Story everyday. 

For more information about Commendations, see the "Raids" section.

#listheader#The Age of Ultron#/listheader#
#emphasis#The Age of Ultron#/emphasis# is available from the #emphasis#Challenges#/emphasis# tab of the M.A.P. menu (this is the menu that appears when clicking on a Waypoint).

Heroes face four challenges in #emphasis#The Age of Ultron#/emphasis#. They must rescue civilians, police, and S.H.I.E.L.D. agents from Ultron Sentry units, protect and activate an EMP to stop the sentries, defeat Ultron's Iron Legion, and then face off against Ultron Prime.

Each of the challenges in The Age of Ultron is timed as an individual phase, and players can earn a Gold, Silver, or Bronze ranking for each challenge based on how quickly the group is able to complete each phase.

The Age of Ultron challenge is designed for a group of five players with level 60 heroes. It will be difficult for smaller groups and may be impossible for solo players.

Heroes enter Central Park at different locations and, if defeated, will start again from their initial location.

Loot in The Age of Ultron challenge is awarded after defeating Ultron Prime and is based off of the group's ranking in each phase. Players can play this mode and earn loot as often as they would like, even on the same hero.

#red#TIP – Help Out Fallen Allies! #/red#
Time is of the essence in The Age of Ultron. Revive your fallen allies whenever possible. Central Park has a lot of ground to cover, and the time it takes to run from the starting area to an objective after being defeated could mean the difference between one ranking and the next.

#listheader#Raids#/listheader#
#emphasis#Raids#/emphasis# are some of the most difficult challenges available.

At level 60 you can participate in Raids. During the Raids, a group of players face several Raid Bosses. Raid Bosses are much more difficult than other Super Villains and require more strategy to defeat. Players may also have other objectives while facing Raid Bosses, such as protecting NPCs.

When facing a Raid Boss, heroes in the group can only be defeated a limited number of times. If the total number of hero defeats during a Raid Boss encounter meets or exceeds this number, all progress in that Raid Boss encounter will be reset and the players will have to try again.

Raids are designed for groups of 10 well-geared players. Players new to raiding should start by attempting Muspelheim Raid at the easiest setting.

Loot from Raids is limited by hero. After a player has completed a raid encounter as one hero during the week, they will not be able to get loot from doing the same encounter as that hero for the rest of that week.

#red#Commendations#/red#
In addition to gear, artifacts, and similar loot, players can also earn Commendations (Hero's, Protector's, and Champion's) from raids once per week. Typically, players can earn 25 Commendations from a Raid Boss, with an extra 25 Commendations from the final Raid Boss of a Raid.

Commendations are an end-game currency used to buy item upgrade recipes, Raid Unique recipes, and other items to make level 60 heroes even more powerful. Players can spend Commendations at Hogun (Raid Token Vendor) in Odin's Palace. After earning enough Influence with the G.L.F in Hammer Bay, Madison Jeffries (G.L.F. Quartermaster) will also have some items available for purchase with Commendations.
There is a weekly cap to the amount of Commendations a player can earn. This cap applies to each type of Commendation individually. After reaching the weekly cap for a specific type of Commendation, no more Commendations of that type will drop until this cap is reset.

#listheader#"Patrol" Modes#/listheader#
"Patrol" Modes, including Industry City Patrol, Midtown Patrol, and Hightown are available from the "Challenges" section of the M.A.P. Interface.

In #emphasis#"Patrol" Modes#/emphasis#, players face many different types of enemies and super villains.

Midtown is a large, open environment where never-ending ambushes of enemies and multiple super villains lay waste to the city. Defeat ambushes and super villain teams for special rewards. Super Villain teams will spawn every few minutes, while some Super Villains (Black Cat and Man-Ape) will appear throughout the city and return shortly after being defeated.

Midtown Patrol is available at level 1.

Industry City is a smaller, faster-paced environment than midtown. Similar to Midtown, some Super Villains (Batroc, Mister Hyde, and Kirigi) will appear throughout the city and return shortly after being defeated. Different challenges called "phases" are presented to players while they are in Industry City. Players work together to complete each phase, earning an Industry City Reward Box for each phase they participate in that is completed successfully.

Industry City Patrol becomes available at level 10.

Hightown is a large environment where the Skrull Army has taken over and wants to expand, starting with the city. Defeat invaders and Super Villains for special rewards. Skrull Invaders will spawn every few minutes, while some Super Villains (Kirgi, Kingpin, and Gorgon) will appear throughout the city and return shortly after being defeated.

Hightown Patrol is available after you defeat Kl'rt in the Story Mode for the first time.

At level 60, Cosmic versions of Midtown Patrol, Industry City Patrol, and Hightown Patrol become available to players. These areas are much more difficult than their normal counterparts, but offer better loot (including better chances at boss-specific artifacts and uniques). Be warned, Cosmic "Patrol" Modes are some of the most difficult areas outside of Raids.

#red#TIP – Cosmic Trial! #/red#
In order to enter the Cosmic versions of Patrols, you must first complete the Cosmic Trial!

#listheader#X-Defense and Holo-Sim#/listheader#

X-Defense and Holo-Sim are wave-based gameplay modes. At the end of a session in one of these modes, a chest is spawned which contains loot based on how many waves were completed successfully.

Both X-Defense and Holo-Sim are available starting at level 1.

In X-Defense, you and four other heroes will fight enemies and Super Villains with a rapidly increasing difficulty and sets of rewards. Protect the trapped X-Students (indicated by the green edge arrow) while simultaneously defeating the attacking waves of enemies and bosses. With each wave, the difficulty will increase. When the X-Students are finally defeated, the game mode will end.

In Holo-Sim, you (and a partner, if desired) will face a variety of waves with a rapidly increasing difficulty and sets of rewards. Survive for as many waves as you can while defeating swarms of enemies, protecting NPCs, and facing challenging Super Villains. After two hero defeats, the game mode will end.

#listheader#The Danger Room#/listheader#

The Danger Room is an area is Xavier's School that becomes unlocked once you reach level 60.

Inside the Danger Room, you and up to four other heroes will face off against several different challenges leading to a boss based on the quality of the #red#Scenario Chip#/red# you used.

Scenario Chips can be acquired from either crafting them using the required materials, or found from many enemies within the game. Some special ones can even be bought from the Danger Room vendor during certain events.

Just like your gear, Scenario Chips also come in several qualities which increase their difficulty and rewards. The Scenario Chips range from #gray#Common#/gray# to #gold#Unique#/gold#

#red#TIP – Joining These Game Modes#/red#
The above game modes (The Age of Ultron, Raids, "Patrol" Modes, X-Defense, and Holo-Sim) can be found in the Challenges tab of the M.A.P. menu.

11919530679495361862.String:
The Savage Land is an even more fascinating place than you might guess. 

It was created by alien visitors called the Nuwali about 200 million years ago. They built it as a game preserve, stocking it first with dinosaurs of the era and later with additional prehistoric creatures.

Despite being surrounded by the frozen waste of Antarctica, the Savage Land retains a tropical climate thanks to amazingly advanced machinery that regulates the weather.

In addition to dinosaurs and other beasts, many humanoid tribes call the Savage Land home. Some, such as the #emphasis#Fall Tribe#/emphasis#, are friendly. Others don't welcome strangers.

The X-Men have a few friends in the Savage Land, most notably #emphasis#Ka-Zar#/emphasis# and #emphasis#Shanna#/emphasis#, who live with the Fall Tribe. Unfortunately our enemies there outnumber our friends, so watch your step.

12433885483079632139.String:
#listheader#CONSOLE **** CREATE POWERFUL ITEMS FOR YOUR HEROES!#/listheader#
The crafting system of Marvel Heroes provides three ways to improve your hero: improving your existing gear; adding special game effects to your costume; and creating consumable items that provide short-term benefits.

#listheader#Visit a CRAFTER#/listheader#
Each base has a special vendor, called a #emphasis#crafter#/emphasis#, who can create or improve items for you. The first crafter you meet is Hank Pym, found in Avengers Tower. 

#listheader#Crafting uses RECIPES#/listheader#
Everything that you can build or improve requires its own #emphasis#recipe#/emphasis#: a list of ingredients required for that task. The recipes available to you appear in your crafter's vendor panel.  

#mission#Mouse over#/mission# a recipe to see more details about it, including its required ingredients.

As your crafter gains #emphasis#ranks#/emphasis# (see below), he or she will offer a wider range of recipes. You can also find new recipes by defeating enemies. When you have a new recipe in your inventory, just #mission#Use this item#/mission# on the recipe to add it to your crafter's list of recipes.

#red#Watch Out! All Recipes Require Credits#/red#
In addition to the ingredients listed, all recipes also require the expenditure of credits. 

#red#Tip! All Crafters Are The Same#/red#
Even though your crafters have different names, they all share the same rank and know the same recipes. 

#listheader#Recipes require ELEMENTS#/listheader#
The simplest ingredients used in recipes are called #emphasis#elements#/emphasis#. Almost any recipe you encounter will require at least one element. 

There are four kinds of elements:
-	#emphasis#Ionic Particle#/emphasis#
-	#emphasis#Nanotech Filament#/emphasis#
-	#emphasis#Astral Essence#/emphasis#
-	#emphasis#Enhanced Genome#/emphasis#

You can find elements by defeating enemies.

#listheader#Crafters have a RANK#/listheader#
Just like your hero starts at level 1, each crafter starts at #emphasis#rank#/emphasis# 1. A crafter's rank determines which recipes that crafter knows. As the crafter gains ranks, the list of recipes available to you from that crafter expands.

You can increase a crafter's rank by donating unwanted items to any crafter. This works a lot like selling items to a vendor. When the crafter panel is open, #mission#hold ALT and Use this item#/mission# on the item you want to donate. This destroys the item and gives the crafter some #emphasis#XP#/emphasis#. When the crafter's yellow XP bar fills up, the crafter advances to the next rank.

#red#Tip! Better Items Are Worth More XP#/red#
The more valuable the item you donate, the more XP the crafter earns. Hold down #mission#ALT#/mission# when the crafter panel is open to see how much XP your inventory items are worth.

#red#Tip! All Crafters Are The Same#/red#
We said it before, but it's worth stating again. All your crafters have the same rank and know the same recipes. Donating an item to any crafter gives XP to all of your crafters.

#listheader#It's time to CRAFT SOMETHING#/listheader#
When you want a crafter to create or improve an item, follow this procedure.

#mission#Left-click#/mission# on the crafter to bring up the crafter panel.
- 	#mission#Left-click#/mission# on the recipe you want to use.
- 	#mission#Use this item#/mission# on the ingredients in your inventory that the recipe requires.
- 	If needed, #mission#Use this item#/mission# on the item the recipe will modify.
- 	Once all ingredients the recipe needs have been added, the Create button will highlight.
- 	#mission#Left-click#/mission# the Create button to complete the recipe.
- 	Wait for the crafting process to finish.
- 	#mission#Left-click#/mission# the Take All Items button to put the crafted or modified item(s) into your inventory.

#red#Watch Out! Crafting Is Final#/red#
You can't undo crafting, so once you make or modify an item, you've permanently lost the materials and the credits that went into making it. Be sure you really want to craft that item before you click Create!

#emphasis#Advanced Idea Mechanics#/emphasis# is a terrorist organization that seeks to overthrow all world governments by technological means. They're basically all super-genius science-types, but apparently none of them bothered to learn how to have a conscience.

A.I.M. gets its funding by supplying high-tech weapons to various other criminal groups. They also have a tendency to run extremely dangerous experiments on unwilling subjects.

Their leader's name is #emphasis#M.O.D.O.K.#/emphasis#, which—and I am not making this up—stands for Mental Organism Designed Only for Killing. He used to be just another scientist but then they transformed him into a misshapen living computer. Just thinking about this guy gives me the creeps.

If you run into any of these yellow-suited guys over on the docks, please put a stop to whatever they're up to.

Thanks.

When the time-travelling mutant #emphasis#Cable#/emphasis# arrived at the school, he wasted little time in transforming the New Mutants into the hard-edged combat squad called #emphasis#X-Force#/emphasis#. Adding real fighters such as Feral, Shatterstar, and Warpath sent a signal to the other team members that class time was over.

The group took on some heavyweight villains along the way, most notably Cable's evil clone #emphasis#Stryfe#/emphasis#.

Over time the team kinda fell apart, but recently it reformed as a squad of mutants tasked with taking care of problems too grisly for the X-Men to handle. Wolverine recruited several mutants who weren't afraid to get their hands dirty, including Archangel, X-23, Caliban, myself, and even...sigh...Deadpool.

Of course, there have been many other spinoff groups and splinter teams of mutants over the years, but hopefully that's enough for the students of #mission#Dani Moonstar#/mission#.

In Giant Battle PvP, two teams of 5 escort Asgardian giants into the other team's base, destroying the enemy's spires along the way.  The spires pack a big wallop, so don't try to take them on alone – fight alongside your teammates and your team's giants.

13075925704478426379.String:
Thank you, $AvatarName$, for your help fending off the Mindless Ones in Midtown. Doctor Strange and I have uncovered the source of the invasion, and the truth is worse than we thought. 

A former sorcerer from our order, Kaecilius, has been corrupted with power and was summoning the dark portals. The event was nothing more than a deadly ruse, however. While we were distracted, Kaecilius entered Strange's Sanctum Sanctorum and stole the Cauldron of the Cosmos, an artifact of great power.

Kaecilius is using the cauldron as a catalyst for a spell that could end our very existence! Put simply, the spell collapses all known dimensions upon each other, and the result...Armageddon.

His motivations are unclear, but Kaecilius' lust for destruction is unquestionable. Strange and I are using our power to delay the effects of the colliding dimensions, so it is up to you to stop Kaecilius. I can take you to the besieged area of Times Square, close to the mad sorcerer.

(GO TO CHALLENGES AND SELECT THE DIMENSIONS COLLIDE WAYPOINT)

When bitten by a radioactive spider, young Peter Parker gained great agility and strength, as well as a precognitive "spider-sense." But after learning that his beloved Uncle Ben had been murdered by a thief that Peter himself had selfishly allowed to escape, Peter realized that with his powers also came a responsibility to use them for good.

Since that day, Spider-Man has fought evil while enduring negative press, personal losses, and the occasional crisis of confidence. Somehow he maintains a positive attitude and never lacks for a humorous quip when battling bad guys.

13308403028615955773.String:
You wanna learn about Mystique's #emphasis#Brotherhood of Mutants#/emphasis#? Well, you're talkin' to the right gal.

#emphasis#Mystique#/emphasis# took me in when I was a kid, takin' advantage of my loneliness an' my uncontrollable powers to twist me into a weapon and recruit me into her Brotherhood. On my first mission, I accidentally absorbed the powers an' memories of Ms. Marvel—permanently! 

I then used those powers to take on the Avengers alongside the rest of Mystique's team—Blob, Pyro, Avalanche, and Destiny—in what turned out to be quite a knock-down battle royale!

After a few more missions with Mystique's team, I started havin' psychological problems thanks to the Carol Danvers personality rollin' around in my head. Mystique was no help, so I turned to #emphasis#Professor Charles Xavier#/emphasis# an' the X-Men for help. They took me in, an' I've been here ever since.

For a while Mystique even convinced the U.S. Government to sponsor her group as their very own team of super-mutants called #emphasis#Freedom Force#/emphasis#.

I'm sorry about the pain I caused working with the Brotherhood, an' I've never regretted walking away from that life. But there will always be folks like #emphasis#Magneto#/emphasis# who think that hurtin' people is the right way to make a point, and  thugs like #emphasis#Toad#/emphasis#, #emphasis#Blob#/emphasis#, and #emphasis#Pyro#/emphasis#, who are happy to go along for the ride.

13481334329155585381.String:
After a tremendous journey wading through wave after wave of Skrulls, you've finally finished it all.

Once you'd cleared out the Skrulls impersonating various heroes in New York, you made your way to Hightown: the wealthiest district in Madripoor. Once you were on site, you located the local S.W.O.R.D. Commander at the safe zone overlooking the city.

He sent you to various locations within Hightown to shut down Skrull devices known as "anchors". They were well guarded, but you were more than capable at dealing with them and disabling the anchors.

With the anchors disabled, the Skrull battleship, which was cloaked and moored to the side of the Sovereign Hotel, was forced to de-cloak and revealed your final objective. You made your way there and boarded the ship.

Finally, aboard the battleship, you encountered the leader of the Skrulls: General Kl'rt. He threw all those powers at you, but you proved the stronger and defeated him.
